correctness.rationale: The expected future descendant-subtree size n/j is independent of the parent of j, and moving that parent changes exactly the descendants’ depths. Thus Cov(1{P_j=i},T_n)=n(1+H_{i-1}-H_{j-1})/[j(j-1)]. Summing and telescoping gives the stated exact covariance; each new normalized summand eventually is strictly negative, and S_infty=(i-1)/i²-Σ_{j>i}j^{-2}=-1/(2i²)+O(i^{-3})<0. Tail comparison gives i² S_{floor(c i² log i),i}->1/c-1/2; unique sign crossing implies N_i/(i² log i)->2. Algebra is correct for i=n, root and n=2 as well. Finite enumeration is supportive, not proof.
